prompt: I want to add a new rule to my project. We keep having issues where developers use console.log for debugging and forget to remove them before committing. My rules are in .claude/rules/team-standards.md. Can you create a rule for this?

assertions.text: The skill discovers and reads the existing rules file before writing anything
It asks which section the rule belongs in (or suggests Code Style)
The rule text is one clear imperative sentence, not a paragraph or multi-sentence explanation
The rule is classified as T1 (console.log has a clear syntactic signature)
The enforcement block has a regex pattern matching console.log
The rule is appended to an appropriate section, not dumped at the end of the file
Budget checks run after generating the block
